newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Niugini's Red Dome Q4 gold output up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Niugini's Red Dome Q4 gold output up.

text.p: Australia-based resources company Niugini Mining Ltd said on Wednesday gold equivalent production from its Red Dome mine in Queensland totalled 29,243 ounces in the fourth quarter ended December 31, up from 26,394 ounces in the previous quarter.
Total operating costs at the mine declined to an average US$268 an ounce from US$304 over the previous three months.
Red Dome is scheduled to cease production in the third quarter of 1997.
Red Dome produced 118,672 ounces of gold equivalent in calendar 1996, Niugini figures show.
Equivalent ounces measure the production of other metals and equates them into gold terms.
Niugini calculates that one ounce of silver equals 0.0133 ounces of gold, while one tonne of copper equals 6.12 ounces of gold.

Gold production at Niugini's San Cristobal deposit in Chile, also nearing the end of its mine life, increased marginally to 19,193 ounces in the fourth quarter from 18,968 ounces in the previous quarter, the company said.
Mining of ore at San Cristobal is scheduled to continue until the fourth quarter of 1998, with residual recoveries from the heaps extending into 1999, Niugini said.

Niugini said it also has resolved to write down the value of San Cristobal by US$15.728 million, and adjoining exploration prospects by US$1.357 million to reflect recent detailed mine studies and exploration reviews.
The company also said a restructuring plan has been prepared that calls for a focus on exploration in the Chillangoe district of Australia and a new mining plan for San Cristobal.
